coordinate_format.origin_definition: origin_mm is the physical DICOM-LPS coordinate in mm of the CENTER of saved voxel [0,0,0].
coordinate_format.final_volume_reference: The origin_mm value in meta.json refers to the CENTER of saved voxel [0,0,0] of the final volume (volume_hu_cropped.npy and aligned masks).
coordinate_format.origin_mm_definition: origin_mm is the physical DICOM-LPS coordinate [LPS x, LPS y, LPS z] of the CENTER of saved CT voxel [0,0,0] in volume_hu_cropped.npy.

coordinate_vector_semantics.physical_vector: [LPS x, LPS y, LPS z] in millimetres
coordinate_vector_semantics.direction_matrix: Columns of direction_lps give the physical LPS direction of the array Z, Y, X axes respectively.

coordinate_format.ct_origin_reference: This is the cropped Stage 01 CT frame. A Z-crop changes origin_mm while preserving voxel spacing and direction_lps; no resampling is performed by Stage 01.
coordinate_format.anatomical_coordinate_note: Anatomical localization is attached to detector candidates and patches; it does not change the voxel or DICOM-LPS coordinate frame.

outputs.volume_hu.npy: float32, complete HU volume before Z-cropping
outputs.volume_hu_cropped.npy: float32, final Z-cropped HU result volume
outputs.volume_hu_masked.npy: float32, final Z-cropped volume with voxels outside lung_mask blanked to the configured physical-air HU
outputs.volume_windowed.npy: uint8, final Z-cropped 3-channel volume [lung window, soft-tissue window, bone window]
outputs.meta.json: per-patient metadata conforming to this coordinate convention
outputs.anatomical_location: Heuristic anatomical localization attached to each detector candidate and extracted patch; not a new segmentation mask.
outputs.03_nodule_classification: Stage 03 per-patch nodule attribute predictions, attention weights, and provenance.

input_volume.description: Final Z-cropped, unmasked HU volume used for detection and patch extraction.

authoritative_detector.name: ViTDet3D

normalization.note: These normalization constants are specific to the pretrained ViTDet3D detector.

authoritative_detector.candidate_center_authority: center_zyx is the detector proposal center retained after NMS; downstream patch cropping uses this native CT voxel coordinate. NMS discards redundant lower-scoring detections and does not average centers.

candidate_physical_coordinate.definition: DICOM-LPS [x,y,z] millimetre coordinate of center_zyx mapped through origin_mm, spacing_zyx_mm, and direction_lps.

patch_coordinate_conventions.patch_origin_definition: patch_origin_lps_mm is the physical DICOM-LPS [x,y,z] coordinate of the CENTER of saved patch voxel [0,0,0]. It is computed from the source CT origin and crop_start_zyx, so it remains valid even when the requested crop extends outside the native CT and is filled with virtual air padding.
patch_coordinate_conventions.patch_spacing_definition: patch_spacing_zyx_mm equals the source CT spacing_zyx_mm because patches are cropped without resampling.
patch_coordinate_conventions.patch_center_definition: patch_center_local_zyx is the nearest integer voxel location of the authoritative detector center inside the saved patch.
patch_coordinate_conventions.bbox_local_mapping: bbox_local_start_zyx = bbox_start_zyx - crop_start_zyx and bbox_local_end_zyx = bbox_end_zyx - crop_start_zyx, clipped to the saved patch bounds for visualization/statistics.

patch_record_fields.patch_id: Sequential patch identifier assigned during extraction.
patch_record_fields.center_zyx: Authoritative detector center in source CT voxel coordinates.
patch_record_fields.center_lps_mm: Same center expressed in DICOM-LPS millimetres.
patch_record_fields.source_clip_start_zyx: Portion of crop intersecting the source CT.
patch_record_fields.source_clip_end_zyx: Portion of crop intersecting the source CT, exclusive.
patch_record_fields.patch_center_local_zyx: Nearest integer voxel to the detector center within patch coordinates.
patch_record_fields.patch_size_vox_zyx: Saved patch shape in ZYX voxels.
patch_record_fields.spacing_zyx_mm: Native CT spacing inherited by the patch.
patch_record_fields.direction_lps: Same axis-direction matrix as the source CT.
patch_record_fields.bbox_start_zyx: Detector bounding-box start in source CT ZYX voxel coordinates.
patch_record_fields.bbox_end_zyx: Detector bounding-box end in source CT ZYX voxel coordinates.
patch_record_fields.bbox_local_start_zyx: Detector bounding-box start in patch-local ZYX coordinates.
patch_record_fields.bbox_local_end_zyx: Detector bounding-box end in patch-local ZYX coordinates.
patch_record_fields.bbox_size_vox_zyx: Bounding-box extent along source CT Z/Y/X axes.
patch_record_fields.bbox_size_mm_zyx: Bounding-box physical extent along source CT Z/Y/X axes, in millimetres.
patch_record_fields.padding_value_hu: HU used for out-of-volume patch padding; default -1000.
patch_record_fields.intensity_statistics: HU statistics for detector-bbox voxels and surrounding native CT context.
patch_record_fields.anatomical_location: Heuristic anatomical localization object copied from the authoritative candidate; uses the same detector center and CT geometry.

outputs.candidates.json: Authoritative validated, deduplicated ViTDet3D candidate set.
outputs.detector_metadata.json: Detector, CT-frame, patch-frame, and provenance metadata.
outputs.patches/patches_manifest.json: Per-patch geometry, coordinates, provenance, and characterization.

anatomical_localization.purpose: Describe where a ViTDet3D detector proposal lies within the existing Stage 01 lung/air/heart masks.

coordinate_rules.laterality_rule: DICOM-LPS +X is patient left. Candidate LPS X above the lung centroid X is labeled left; below is right; within the configured tolerance is midline/central.

anatomical_location_fields.laterality: left, right, midline, midline_or_central, or unknown.
anatomical_location_fields.compartment: airway, lung_wall, parenchyma, mediastinum, or outside_lung.
anatomical_location_fields.vertical_region: superior, middle, inferior, or unknown based on axial lung extent.
anatomical_location_fields.wall_relationship: Relationship to the Stage 01 lung-mask boundary.
anatomical_location_fields.distance_to_lung_mask_mm: Local physical distance to the lung-mask boundary.
anatomical_location_fields.airway_proximity_mm: Local physical distance to the retained central airway proxy.
anatomical_location_fields.center_inside_lung_mask: Whether the rounded detector center lies in lung_mask.npy.
anatomical_location_fields.center_inside_heart_mask: Whether the rounded detector center lies in heart_mask.npy.
anatomical_location_fields.center_lps_mm: DICOM-LPS physical coordinate of the detector center.
anatomical_location_fields.limitations: Explicit statement that this is heuristic rather than clinical anatomical segmentation.

output_locations.candidates.json: Each authoritative ViTDet3D candidate contains anatomical_location.
output_locations.candidates.csv: Flat anatomical location columns mirror anatomical_location.primary, region, laterality, and compartment.
output_locations.patches/patches_manifest.json: Each extracted patch record contains the same anatomical_location object copied from its authoritative candidate.
output_locations.detector_metadata.json: Contains the anatomical-localization configuration used for the run.

anatomical_localization.limitations: No dedicated anatomical atlas or airway segmentation model is used. Trachea/bronchus labels are inferred from the Stage 01 physical-air mask and central 3-D connectivity; lung-wall labels use local distance to the Stage 01 lung-mask boundary. These labels are for pipeline localization/QA and should not be treated as clinical anatomy.

outputs.final: 9 sigmoid outputs in [0,1]; authoritative attribute predictions
outputs.aux: 9 sigmoid auxiliary ASCMM predictions retained for provenance
outputs.slice_attention: one weight per input axial slice

preprocessing.batching: one nodule patch at a time; slices are presented as the model batch dimension

prediction_semantics.score_0_1: Normalized model sigmoid output, not a calibrated class probability.
prediction_semantics.rating_original_scale: Reference LIDC rating scale recovered from the normalized score.
prediction_semantics.malignancy: Model output is the LIDC 1-to-5 malignancy rating; Stage 03 does not convert it to a binary probability.
prediction_semantics.anatomical_location: Copied from the Stage 02 authoritative candidate/patch record; Stage 03 does not alter it.

coordinate_conventions.source_ct_origin_definition: origin_lps_mm is the LPS coordinate of the center of source CT voxel [0,0,0].
coordinate_conventions.patch_origin_definition: patch_origin_lps_mm is the LPS coordinate of the center of patch voxel [0,0,0].
coordinate_conventions.prediction_center: center_zyx remains the Stage 02 detector center and is not recomputed by Stage 03.

prediction_record_fields.center_zyx: Authoritative Stage 02 detector center in source CT coordinates.
prediction_record_fields.patch_origin_lps_mm: Physical center coordinate of patch voxel [0,0,0].
prediction_record_fields.spacing_zyx_mm: Native Stage 02 spacing inherited by the patch.
prediction_record_fields.attributes: Nine final attribute predictions with normalized and original-scale values plus auxiliary scores.
prediction_record_fields.patch_array_path: Source patch array used for inference.

limitations: The supplied model predicts normalized LIDC attribute ratings; score_0_1 values should not be interpreted as calibrated probabilities.
The malignancy output is a 1-to-5 LIDC rating after inverse scaling, not a binary benign/malignant probability.
The supplied model source does not define a binary classification threshold, so Stage 03 does not invent one.
Absolute prediction validity depends on using a trained checkpoint compatible with the supplied Network architecture and the reference preprocessing domain.
